rows.label: Derrick Henry
rows.hook: is a bruising running back nicknamed King, who ran for over 2,000 yards in an NFL season

rows.label: Jayden Daniels
rows.hook: is a dual-threat quarterback who went second in the draft after a record-setting season

rows.label: Fernando Mendoza
rows.hook: is a quarterback who led a long-struggling program to an unbeaten regular season and a national title run

rows.label: Marcus Mariota
rows.hook: is a quarterback who was the second pick in the draft after a dominant season with the Ducks

rows.label: Kyler Murray
rows.hook: is a quarterback who was picked first in the NFL draft after also being picked ninth in the baseball draft

rows.label: Caleb Williams
rows.hook: is a quarterback who won the award and was then the first pick in the draft by the Chicago Bears

rows.label: Joe Burrow
rows.hook: is a record-setting quarterback who went first in the draft and later led the Bengals to the Super Bowl

rows.label: Baker Mayfield
rows.hook: is a brash quarterback who planted a flag at midfield in a rival's stadium and went first in the draft

rows.label: Lamar Jackson
rows.hook: is a dazzling running quarterback who became the youngest to win the award and later an NFL MVP for the Ravens

rows.label: Tim Tebow
rows.hook: is a quarterback and devout Christian famed for kneeling in prayer, who later tried pro baseball

rows.label: Johnny Manziel
rows.hook: is a freewheeling scrambling quarterback who was the first freshman ever to take the award

rows.label: Bo Jackson
rows.hook: is a two-sport legend who starred in both the NFL and Major League Baseball and starred in the "Bo Knows" ads

rows.label: Cam Newton
rows.hook: is a huge quarterback who led his team to a national title in a single season and went first in the draft

rows.label: Matt Leinart
rows.hook: is a quarterback who won the award in the same era the Trojans were chasing a national title three-peat

rows.label: Travis Hunter
rows.hook: is a two-way star who played both receiver and cornerback and won the award while playing for Coach Prime

rows.label: DeVonta Smith
rows.hook: is a slender receiver who was the first of his position in decades to win, after a huge title-game night

rows.label: Robert Griffin III
rows.hook: is a quarterback known by his initials and a number, taken second in the draft after an electric season

rows.label: Barry Sanders
rows.hook: is a Hall of Fame running back famed for elusive moves, who starred for the Lions

rows.label: Eddie George
rows.hook: is a durable running back who later became the face of the Tennessee Titans' offense

rows.label: Doug Flutie
rows.hook: is a pint-sized quarterback famous for a last-second Hail Mary pass to beat Miami

rows.label: Sam Bradford
rows.hook: is a quarterback who was the first pick in the draft and later battled injuries in the pros

rows.label: Desmond Howard
rows.hook: is a returner remembered for striking a pose after a long touchdown and later being Super Bowl MVP

rows.label: Roger Staubach
rows.description: American football player and Navy officer (born 1942)
rows.hook: is a quarterback who served in the military before becoming a Dallas Cowboys legend nicknamed Captain Comeback

rows.label: Ricky Williams
rows.hook: is a running back who broke the major-college career rushing record, later played for the Dolphins

rows.label: Herschel Walker
rows.description: American diplomat and former football player (born 1962)
rows.hook: was a powerhouse running back who later took up bobsled and mixed martial arts

rows.label: Charles Woodson
rows.hook: is a defensive back who was the first primarily defensive player to win, later a Hall of Fame cornerback

rows.label: Mark Ingram
rows.hook: is a running back who won the award in a very close vote and later played for the Saints and Ravens

rows.label: Carson Palmer
rows.hook: is a quarterback who went first in the draft, then led the Bengals and later played for the Cardinals

rows.label: Marcus Allen
rows.hook: is a running back who rushed for over 2,000 yards in a season and was Super Bowl MVP with the Raiders

rows.label: Vinny Testaverde
rows.description: All-American college football player, professional football player, quarterback, Heisman Trophy winner
rows.hook: is a quarterback who was the first pick in the draft and played for many NFL teams over a long career

rows.label: Charlie Ward
rows.hook: is a quarterback who also starred in college basketball and later played for the New York Knicks

rows.label: Ty Detmer
rows.hook: is a quarterback who passed for huge yardage in a pass-heavy offense and later had a pro career as a backup

rows.label: Chris Weinke
rows.hook: is an older quarterback who had previously played pro minor league baseball before winning the award

rows.label: Jason White
rows.hook: is a quarterback who won the award a year after returning from major knee injuries

rows.label: Eric Crouch
rows.hook: is an option quarterback who later switched to wide receiver in the pros after a standout college career

rows.label: Tim Brown
rows.hook: is a wide receiver and returner who later spent most of his pro career with the Raiders

rows.label: Andre Ware
rows.hook: is a quarterback who was the first Black signal-caller to win the award, in a run-and-shoot offense
